Shame
Jul 2026 • Family
Avoid this place if you expect good service.

The View may have a beautiful location and nicely presented food, but the service completely ruined our experience.

We were among the first guests in the restaurant, and it wasn’t busy at all. Despite that, we had to wave at the staff for about two minutes before anyone bothered to come to our table. They seemed far more interested in their phones than in their guests.

From that moment on, we had to ask for absolutely everything.

No wasabi with our order—we had to ask.
No napkins—we had to ask.
We needed hot water to prepare porridge for our baby—we had to ask.
Then we needed a small bowl—we had to ask again.
Then a high chair for our child—again, we had to ask.

At no point did the staff show any initiative or attention to basic customer needs. It felt as if serving guests was an inconvenience rather than their job.

The final insult came with the bill. After spending several million VND on our meal, we discovered that the restaurant had charged us for the hot water we requested solely to prepare food for our baby.

That was simply embarrassing.

A restaurant’s quality is not measured by its view or by how beautifully food is presented. It is measured by hospitality, professionalism, and service. Unfortunately, The View failed in all three.

This was one of the most disappointing restaurant experiences we’ve had in Da Nang. We will not be returning, and we cannot recommend this place to anyone looking for a restaurant that genuinely values its guests.

I sincerely hope the management spends less money on decoration and more on training their staff.

A nice place to enjoy good food and a relaxing view
Jan 2026 • Friends
I had a really pleasant experience at The View Da Nang. The atmosphere was calm and comfortable, especially in the evening when the view was very nice and relaxing. The food was well-prepared and tasted fresh, with a good variety on the menu. Portions were reasonable and the presentation was simple but appealing.
The staff were polite and attentive without being overbearing, which made the dining experience more enjoyable. Service was fairly quick even though the restaurant was quite busy at the time.
Overall, it’s a good place to enjoy a meal while taking in the city view. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a nice spot to have dinner in Da Nang, especially if you want somewhere not too noisy.
